context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure package's login hook, including importing useLogin from the package, passing email/password credentials, CommerceError on missing credentials, and ValidationError on API-level authentication failures.

checklist.name: Import useLogin
checklist.description: The solution imports `useLogin` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` and calls it as a hook to get the login mutation function.

checklist.name: email + password input
checklist.description: The login function is called with `{ email, password }` matching the LoginHook's actionInput shape; the hook internally maps email to the `username` field in the GraphQL mutation.

checklist.name: CommerceError on empty fields
checklist.description: When email or password is empty/falsy, the solution handles or demonstrates the `CommerceError` thrown before any network call.

checklist.name: ValidationError on auth failure
checklist.description: When the API returns an error typename (InvalidCredentialsError, NotVerifiedError, NativeAuthStrategyError), the solution handles or demonstrates the `ValidationError` thrown by the hook.
